title: Evolution of Indications for Transbronchial Ganglionic Ultrasound
brief_summary: New indications for bronchial echo-endoscopies with transbronchial needle aspiration (EBUS-PTBA) have appeared since the first French centers with this technique were fitted. Evaluate the respective share of each indication of EBUS-AWPB over time over the period 2008 - 2013
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who underwent a first linear echo-endoscopy at the CHU of Amiens and the CH of Saint-Quentin between January 2008 and December 2013

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient sent by a center outside Picardie
* Patient having expressed a refusal to participate in the protocol
study_population: Inclusive patients will be made from the computer database of endoscopy services of each of the 2 centers listing endoscopic examinations carried out over the period of interest
